# Orthopedics Treatment Cost in India for Patients from Kenya

**In short:** Orthopedic surgery in India offers Kenyan patients high-quality joint care at a fraction of US or UK prices, with short wait times and dedicated support.

## Why patients from Kenya choose India

- **Significant cost savings:** Orthopedic procedures in India typically cost a fraction of what you would pay in the US or UK, easing the financial burden.
- **Accredited hospitals:** Many Indian hospitals serving international patients hold respected international and national accreditations (such as JCI and NABH), ensuring high standards of care.
- **Short wait times:** You can often schedule and undergo your surgery within weeks rather than facing long waiting lists.
- **Experienced specialists:** India is home to highly skilled orthopedic surgeons who routinely perform complex joint replacement surgeries.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is it safe to have orthopedic surgery in India?**
Yes. Many hospitals catering to international patients maintain strict international safety protocols and hold recognized accreditations, ensuring high standards of patient care.
